## Use Sudo in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Sudo for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Sudo', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Sudo coding font

A programming font with a modern geometric design. Sudo is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Sudo is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Sudo FAQ

### Is Sudo free?

No. Sudo is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Sudo support ligatures?

No. Sudo has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Sudo?

Sudo is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
